# Explicit set of Open CASCADE 8.0.1 toolkits used by bendcore.
#
# One toolkit per line; text after the name and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# Read by:
#   - CMakeLists.txt (BENDCORE_OCCT_TOOLKITS -> OpenCASCADE_LIBRARIES / BENDCORE_OCCT_LIBS);
#     a toolkit missing from BENDCORE_OCCT_DIR/lib is a configuration error;
#   - third_party/build_occt_wasm.sh (BUILD_ADDITIONAL_TOOLKITS of the OCCT WASM build).
# Why each toolkit is here, and what was excluded: docs/kernel/OCCT_BUILD.md.
# Order follows dependencies (dependents after their dependencies); linking is done
# inside --start-group/--end-group, so the order is not load-bearing for GNU ld.

# Foundation
TKernel
TKMath

# Modeling data
TKG2d
TKG3d
TKGeomBase
TKBRep

# Modeling algorithms
TKGeomAlgo
TKTopAlgo
TKPrim
TKShHealing
TKBO
TKBool
TKFeat
TKFillet
TKOffset
TKMesh
TKHLR

# Application framework (OCAF document used by XCAF)
TKCDF
TKLCAF
TKCAF

# Data exchange
TKXSBase
TKDE
TKXCAF
# Required by the linker for TKXCAF (not in the starting list of the roadmap):
# XCAFApp_Application::XCAFApp_Application() registers XCAFPrs_Driver in
# TPrsStd_DriverTable::Get() (TKVCAF); XCAFPrs_Driver/XCAFPrs_AISObject derive from
# AIS_ColoredShape (TKV3d); XCAFDoc_VisMaterial and XCAFPrs_Texture use
# Graphic3d_MaterialAspect / Graphic3d_PBRMaterial / Graphic3d_Texture2D (TKService).
# Without them test_step_reader, test_import_workflow and e2e_import fail to link.
TKVCAF
TKV3d
TKService
TKDESTEP
TKDEIGES
TKDESTL
